Hi, a blumat system uses a moisture-sensing ceramic carrot to control water flow. The sensor reads the moisture in the growing medium and allows water to flow as needed, with water coming from either a raised reservoir or a pressure-reduced source.

For a first setup, use this basic order:

Choose a water source. The easiest first-time setup is a raised reservoir. Never connect raw tap pressure directly.
Set the sensor correctly. If it is a preset Tropf-Blumat sensor, use the supplied starting setting for gravity.
Install the sensor in the growing medium with firm soil contact, ideally halfway between the pot center and wall and about halfway down the soil profile, no deeper than about 6 inches.
Connect the tubing from the supply to the sensor, then to the drippers.
Place the drippers around the root zone for even watering.
Check that all tubing and drippers are connected correctly without opening the sensor.
Test and make small adjustments after the medium has had time to respond.
If you mean the Blumat Classic instead of Tropf-Blumat, the setup is different because Classic does not use an adjustment screw. Which one do you have?
